reason: B opens inside the Zong killings as a scene with dates, counts and physical detail, and only then widens into law, credit, and revolution, so the reader is pulled forward by consequence rather than by exposition. A stays in analytic register throughout and keeps restating one idea - that the Dolben diagram converted bodies into measurable cargo - across many paragraphs before moving on. B's movement from deck to courtroom to Barbados code to Jamaican ledger to Haiti and Louisiana gives a real sense of escalation; A's sections read as parallel surveys of the same point.
